method: One call per measurement window, bracketed by counter reads. Cheapest-risk-first order. Hard ceiling 20 operations.

instrument_correction.why_it_was_wrong: It reports the FREE-TIER monthly bucket (500/month). Charges draw from the BUILDER26 promo bucket, so this counter stayed flat at 5 through every billable call and reported every cost as 0.
instrument_correction.correct_instrument: usage.promotions[0].ops_remaining, returned inside the chat response
instrument_correction.free_counter_read: A chat that makes no edit is not billable (was_billable=false, ops_charged=0) and still returns the usage block. This is a zero-cost way to read the promo counter, confirmed over 3 consecutive reads with the counter flat at 9990.

account.note: get_account_status reports tier 'free' with a 500/month limit; that bucket is NOT what the run spends. The promo bucket is.

evidence.chat_edit_charges_one: three sequential edit chats: remaining 9994 -> 9993 -> 9992, ops_charged=1 each
evidence.non_chat_calls_are_free: 7 non-chat calls bracketed by two no-edit reader chats; promo delta 0
evidence.search_adds_no_surcharge: chat with cross_session_memory+cross_session_search on: ops_charged=1, remaining 9992 -> 9991
evidence.errored_call_not_billed: chat missing required 'message' returned HTTP 422; next reader showed delta of exactly 1, attributable to the reader's own edit
